issues.issue: Whether the claimants' nationality and Coptic Christian identity are established
issues.applicant_position: Claimants are Egyptian Coptic Christians, relying on seized passports and church letters.
issues.result_text: Egyptian nationality and Coptic Christian identity established on balance of probabilities.

issues.issue: Whether the claimants' account of religious persecution is credible
issues.applicant_position: Christian Copts are targeted and assaulted in Egypt; claimants fled after repeated attacks.
issues.result_text: Claimants credible on central elements; evidence consistent with country conditions.

issues.issue: Whether state protection is unavailable and there is a serious possibility of persecution
issues.applicant_position: Police are unwilling to act in religious disputes; claimants fear Muslim extremists if returned.
issues.result_text: Serious possibility of persecution on a Convention ground and clear evidence the state cannot protect.
